2120687042916983236.en_summary: @JonahLupton notes $NVDA down -8.5% after hours and focuses on technicals, seeing possible support at $149.50-153.50 (2024 highs and 150w EMA) but more likely bottoming around $138 (trendline from Jan 2023 lows through April 2025 lows and 200w EMA). At ~$138, $NVDA would trade at 9.1x NTM EPS including net cash of ~$175-200B after next week's earnings, matching its cheapest NTM P/E since 1999 IPO (only prior time Oct 2012).
2120687042916983236.zh_summary: @JonahLupton指出$NVDA盤後下跌-8.5%，專注於技術面，認為可能在$149.50-153.50獲得支持（2024年高點及150週EMA），但更可能在約$138見底（自2023年1月低點至2025年4月低點的趨勢線及200週EMA）。在約$138時，$NVDA將以9.1倍NTM EPS交易（包括淨現金約$175-200B，下週財報後），匹配自1999年IPO以來最便宜的NTM P/E（僅2012年10月曾出現）。

2120685353535152502.en_summary: @InvestmentGuru_ reports $CRWV plans to raise at least $4 billion through an investment-grade loan offering, per Bloomberg. Morgan Stanley and Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group leading the syndicated financing, possibly as soon as next week, backed by chips and related contracts (structure used by CoreWeave for cheaper borrowing).
2120685353535152502.zh_summary: @InvestmentGuru_報告$CRWV計劃透過投資級貸款發行至少籌集$40億，據彭博。摩根士丹利和三菱UFJ金融集團主導辛迪加融資，可能最快下週進行，以晶片及相關合約為抵押（CoreWeave曾用此結構降低借貸成本）。

2120684941344374973.en_summary: @edzitron reacts 'Oh god they’ve lost @Srasgon' to news that Bernstein downgraded $NVDA and cut price target in half to $200 from $400 amid deepening crisis around CEO Jensen Huang. Analyst Stacy Rasgon wrote 'Our gut tells us that we probably haven't yet fully probed the depths of what might be found here' and prefer sidelines. Third downgrade of the day after Aletheia and Baird.
2120684941344374973.zh_summary: @edzitron對Bernstein下調$NVDA並將目標價減半至$200（原$400）的消息反應「天哪他們失去了@Srasgon」，因CEO Jensen Huang危機加深。分析師Stacy Rasgon寫道「我們的直覺告訴我們可能還沒完全探查到可能發現的深度」，偏好觀望。這是當日第三次下調，繼Aletheia和Baird之後。
